Both are already linked to 224 common concepts, including estimation problem, particle system and cev model, which suggests the methods and data needed to connect them already exist. We propose a study that uses estimation problem as a bridge: first, review how convergence rate and log price are each currently treated through estimation problem; second, design an approach that combines them and test it on established benchmarks from both lines of work; third, measure whether the combination improves on each topic studied alone. We expect the work to clarify where the two literatures overlap and to open a new line of research between them.

We expect the work to clarify where the two literatures overlap and to open a new line of research between them.
